features: Seamless 4G LTE SIM Connectivity – Plug & Play Insert any 4G SIM card and instantly convert mobile data into high-speed WiFi. This 4G LTE router delivers up to 150 Mbps download speed (Cat4), making it ideal for homes, offices, retail shops, CCTV systems, and remote locations without fiber broadband.

Advanced Wi-Fi 6 Technology for Strong Wireless Network Powered by WiFi 6 (802.11ax), this wireless router ensures improved bandwidth efficiency, reduced latency, and stable performance across multiple connected devices. Perfect for streaming, video calls, smart TVs, gaming, and work-from-home setups.

High-Gain Antenna for Wider Coverage Equipped with external LTE and WiFi antennas, the Trueview SIM router provides stronger signal reception and extended coverage. Ensures stable connectivity even in low-signal areas.

Secure & Powerful Network Protection Supports WPA2-PSK encryption, firewall, port forwarding, IPv4/IPv6, DHCP, and advanced access control. Protect your network from unauthorized access while maintaining smooth internet performance.

Easy Setup, Multi-OS Compatibility & LAN Support Simple web-based interface for quick setup. Compatible with Windows, MacOS, Android, Linux. Includes RJ45 LAN port (10/100 Mbps) for wired connection to PC, DVR, NVR, or other devices.
